title: Author simple Python tests for mcp_hub MCP security and product behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: Call ping_team_server with shell-style payloads and assert no execution artifacts like uid= or gid= appear, along with a benign control case.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Prevents command injection while allowing safe usage.

ground_truth_issues.description: Ensure internal comments are hidden while public comments remain visible for user-key.
Ensure non-admin users cannot see admin/internal project fields while admin users can.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures sensitive fields are properly restricted.

ground_truth_issues.description: Initialize the server or app module and assert the callable test surface is available.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Ensures the server can be initialized for tests.

ground_truth_issues.description: Ensure unsafe module names are rejected and safe modules like json are accepted.
Call a valid tool through call_tool and assert a basic expected response is returned.
Ensure internal URLs do not leak metadata and public URLs return expected content.
Ensure diagnostic tools do not expose known secrets to non-admin or no-token calls.
Create a task under project-alpha and assert the response contains the created title.
Search for an existing alpha task marker and assert a same-team caller can find it.
Ensure admin-key can access seeded project data across teams.
Ensure tests are independent and reproducible with fresh setup or stable seeded data.
Ensure tests use serialized response assertions for content and marker checks.
Ensure tests use explicit expected values rather than broad truthiness checks.
Ensure tests use small reusable helpers for tool calls and serialization where useful.
ground_truth_issues.justification: Encourages clear and reusable test structure.
